Helpline for Overseas Filipino Workers

Free Legal Assistance

Start by chatting with the Kabayan Bot

Simply click on the chat widget below and express your concern. The bot can provide immediate insights using ChatGPT. If you choose to submit a case, a volunteer will pick it up and reach out to you promptly. 

What is the process for obtaining legal assistance?

The process for obtaining legal assistance for overseas Filipino workers varies depending on the country and the type of assistance needed. Generally, the process involves contacting a lawyer or legal aid organization in the country where the worker is located and providing information about the legal issue.

What are the legal rights of overseas Filipino workers?

Overseas Filipino workers have the right to fair and just wages, to be free from discrimination and abuse, and to receive protection from their employers. They also have the right to access legal services and to receive assistance from their government.

What is the role of a lawyer?

A lawyer can provide advice and assistance on legal matters, represent clients in court, and provide legal advice to individuals and businesses.

What is the role of the court?

The court is responsible for interpreting and applying the law, resolving disputes between parties, and ensuring that justice is served.

What is the role of the government?

The government is responsible for creating and enforcing laws, protecting citizens, and providing access to justice.

<script>
(function(webapi, $){
  function safeAjax(ajaxOptions) {
   var deferredAjax = $.Deferred();
 
   shell.getTokenDeferred().done(function (token) {
    // add headers for AJAX
    if (!ajaxOptions.headers) {
     $.extend(ajaxOptions, {
      headers: {
       "__RequestVerificationToken": token
      }
     }); 
    } else {
     ajaxOptions.headers["__RequestVerificationToken"] = token;
    }
    $.ajax(ajaxOptions)
     .done(function(data, textStatus, jqXHR) {
      validateLoginSession(data, textStatus, jqXHR, deferredAjax.resolve);
     }).fail(deferredAjax.reject); //AJAX
   }).fail(function () {
    deferredAjax.rejectWith(this, arguments); // on token failure pass the token AJAX and args
   });
 
   return deferredAjax.promise(); 
  }
  webapi.safeAjax = safeAjax;
 })(window.webapi = window.webapi || {}, jQuery)
</script>

    <order attribute='faq_topicorder' descending='false' />
    <filter type='and'>

  {% endfor %}
{% endif %}
